subject: OnsiteIQ's Multimodal data management solution
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently released EMM-1
<[LINK]>
-
the world's largest open-source multimodal dataset, with 107 million image,
video, text, audio and point cloud embeddings - and thought it might be
relevant given the work you're doing.

Our engineering team has been building out dataset curation and label
validation tooling specifically for visual AI teams at your stage of scale
- we're working with teams like OnsiteIQ and would love to get your take on
what we've shipped.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute chat to take a look, see if there's
any overlap, and share some honest feedback?

subject: Scaling CV team + pipelines | Working w/ AbbVie, Tractable & Intenseye
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw you're scaling the CV team, with defect detection, quality inspection,
and safety monitoring all in scope.

Tractable and Intenseye came to us when their annotation ops were
bottlenecked; defect ontologies and label consistency stop scaling once you
move past one use case.

Additionally, without a visual way to search for and find rare defects /
edge-case safety scenarios in the data, retraining decisions end up
reactive.

If this is on your radar, it would be worth a 15-min conversation. The
following times work well for me:

   - *Tuesday 28th April*, 10:00
   - *Wednesday 29th April*, 11:00
   - *Wednesday 29th April, *13:00 (I have put in some tentative time here,
   but happy to reschedule according to availability)

subject: Encord <> [COMPANY] | Working w Flatiron Health, AbbVie, Mayo Clinic
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the Polaris win. Predicting ADMET better than 38 competitors in
a blinded challenge is a strong proof point!

I work at Encord. We see teams in the ML biotech world hit friction when
scaling their training infrastructure and iterating on proprietary
datasets. As the consortium grows and more drug programs come online,
internal tooling slows, infrastructure management costs increase and it
becomes harder for the model to efficiently include active learning.

We're a unified multimodal MLOps platform that helps ML teams manage,
curate, and evaluate training data at scale. We're trusted by Flatiron
Health, Target RWE, AbbVie amongst others.

A conversation might be beneficial for both of us, worth 20 minutes?
